Hi Sam — great to connect.

Attaching a lean MAP seed (link below) that we use for 21-day pilots — it has a week-by-week milestone column, clear owner assignments, and an acceptance matrix. I'm proposing the following high-level timeline:

Week 0 (Kickoff, discovery): alignment on success metrics, access to sample/anonymized data, and security packet exchange.
Week 1 (Tech validation): infra baseline + latency/throughput smoke tests; first inference run with sample payloads.
Week 2 (Quality & tuning): prompt/param tuning, small-scale regression checks vs. baseline; run acceptance checklist.

Next steps I suggest:
1) Share the MAP draft: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1MAP-TEMPLATE-SEEDBOARD (view/comment)
2) Quick 60-min tech workshop — Tue 11/2 09:30 PT or Wed 11/3 10:00 PT?
3) I'll loop engineering and CS internally to confirm owners and any pre-checks for SOC/infra.

I'll also include a stub security questionnaire for procurement.

Thanks,
Soojin Lee
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
